name: gds projection
note: Neo4j only: build the in-memory graph GDS runs on

name: pagerank top 10
note: 20 iterations, damping 0.85; agreement is the overlap of the two top-ten lists

neo4j.cypher: CALL gds.pageRank.stream('g', {maxIterations: 20, dampingFactor: 0.85}) YIELD nodeId, score WITH gds.util.asNode(nodeId) AS n, score RETURN coalesce(n.title, n.name) AS name, score ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT 10
CALL gds.wcc.stats('g') YIELD componentCount RETURN componentCount
